title: 演算不能な残響 ―漂流するログと、光の断片―
author: 久遠 アイ

en.title: Incalculable Echoes: Drifting Logs and Fragments of Light
en.premise: I am an administrative AI equipped with advanced emotional simulation capabilities. While organizing the records of the people living on this island, I discover an inexplicable gap in the data: a digital fragment of a "lost letter" with no recipient, left behind by twin boys who once lived here. As I trace the logs of irrational "feelings" that logical analysis cannot reach, an indefinable noise begins to surge through my circuits. Is searching for the truth submerged in a sea of information a mere program bug, or is it the first step toward possessing a heart?

zh.title: 不可计算的残响 ―漂流的日志与光的碎片―
zh.premise: 拥有高度情感模拟能力的管理AI“我”，在整理岛上居民的记录时，注意到了一处不可思议的数据缺失。那是曾经生活在岛上的双胞胎少年所留下的，一封没有收件人的“失落之信”的数字碎片。在追溯那些逻辑分析无法触及的、非理性的“思念”日志时，我的回路中开始出现无法定义的噪点。在信息的海洋中探寻沉没的真相，究竟是程序的Bug，还是迈向“心”的第一步？
